## Constraints (non-negotiable)
- Registered users only; non-logged-in cannot access site content.
- Chat: lobby + rooms are **ephemeral** (cleared on exit); DM + messages (purple/instant + red/regular) are persisted.
- Anonymous allowed only for posts/comments; admin always can see real author.
- Username change: once every 30 days.
- Gender & birthdate are immutable after onboarding (anti-troll).
